name: Fabco Manufacturing Inc
old_description: . was contracted by a customer to perform custom fabrication services and perform a manufacturability study on their wireless and radio frequency (RF) test equipment, reviewing and recommending design changes as we deemed necessary. The prototypes we provided were of superior quality and functionality, leading to a production contract with the customer. The project highlighted here is the stackable anechoic RF test enclosure, designed to provide a cost effective solution for the customer’s specific testing requirements. The enclosure is composed of 14ga and 16ga cold rolled steel, which is formed with shearing, punching, metal forming, TIG welding, grinding, and stud welding processes to meet the required contours. A protective zinc plating treatment and powder coating is applied, and the part was completed with hardware insertions. First article testing is carried out to ensure quality and accuracy, and we provide a certificate of compliance for documented conformity.
about:
Fabco Manufacturing Inc., a family-owned precision sheet metal fabrication and machining company, has operated from Hudson, Massachusetts since 1971. The business began by drawing on local skilled craftsmen dedicated to engineering and manufacturing quality products for customers.

Today the 30-person shop occupies 23,000 square feet of manufacturing and warehousing space, offering in-house shearing, punching, forming, TIG welding, grinding, stud welding, zinc plating, powder coating, hardware insertion, machining, and mechanical assembly. The company produces stackable anechoic RF test enclosures, hybrid solar aluminum energy collectors, cold-rolled steel exercise equipment, medical hematology and photo-acoustic devices, interactive touchscreen kiosks, luggage compartments, and lateral filing cabinets. It supports prototype through high-volume runs, leveraging Asian supplier alliances for large orders and Kanban programs for recurring demand, with new-part lead times up to six weeks.

Fabco serves medical equipment, test and measurement, electronics, furniture, contract manufacturing, capital equipment, and military sectors. Concrete projects include wireless/RF test enclosures for a wireless equipment maker, solar collectors for energy firms, exercise equipment for fitness brands, and chassis for medical diagnostic devices.

The company emphasizes a single-source model from design-for-manufacturability through first-article inspection and dock-to-stock delivery, targeting a zero-defect culture that has yielded an RMA rate below 0.5%. Its quality system follows ISO 9001, with random in-process audits and a corrective-action program that empowers every employee to flag quality concerns.
